description: Percentile bands (p10–p90) for temp, precip, or wind. Hourly p10/p25/p50/p75/p90 bands for one variable at a coordinate. Temperature bands come from the model's empirical calibration; precipitation and wind bands are NWS-derived approximations, disclosed in the response's method label. Metric units (°C, mm, kph). Horizons cap at 168h. Use it to reason about uncertainty, not just point values.
